create_rvt_model: create a Rotary Vision Transformer model for image classification with configurable patch size and depth
build_axial_rotary_embedding: build axial rotary positional embeddings for 2D spatial sequences in vision transformers
test_spatial_conv_attention: test spatial convolution-based attention with depthwise convolutions and rotary embeddings
build_feedforward_geglu: build a feedforward layer using GEGLU activation instead of standard GELU
run_rvt_forward_pass: run a forward pass on the RvT model to classify images into num_classes categories
